The Christie Private Care, Manchester
Full Time, 37.5 hours per week

Permanent

We’re looking for a dedicated Housekeeping Assistant to join our Hotel Services team based at The Christie Private Care in Manchester. Our Hotel Services team plays a vital role in the day‑to‑day running of the hospital, ensuring that all patient rooms, clinical areas and shared spaces are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness, safety and presentation. Working behind the scenes and on the front line, the team helps create a welcoming, calm and hygienic environment where patients can focus on their recovery and visitors feel reassured from the moment they arrive.
As a Housekeeping Assistant, you’ll be a key contributor to the overall patient experience, supporting both care delivery and hospital operations through your attention to detail and commitment to excellence. Day to day, your work will include cleaning patient rooms, public areas and staff spaces, ensuring every area is safe, tidy and presentable. No two days are ever quite the same, and you’ll work closely with clinical and non‑clinical colleagues to support the smooth running of the hospital. This is a hands‑on, rewarding role where your work is immediately visible and genuinely valued, offering the opportunity to make a difference every single day.
Above all else, we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life. It’s this guiding vision that influences everything we do at HCA UK. From the CEO to the colleagues on the floor we all have a part to play in delivering exceptional care to our patients. Other’s may think this is just a role in Hotel Services but to us, you’ll be part of a wider team with a unique sense of purpose, one that helps improve lives on a daily basis.
What you’ll do:
• You’ll be passionate both patient care and cleanliness – someone who is able to communicate effectively with patients, visitors, and healthcare staff.
• You’ll also be comfortable working in a hospital environment and coming into contact with patients.
• Our communal areas are clean and tidy for visitors,
• To perform any tasks specifically assigned to you.
• To carry out any other tasks assigned by the Supervisor or designee.
• Attend mandatory training on annual basis.
What you’ll bring:
• be aware of hygiene standards.
• be passionate about customer care.
• be able to communicate effectively with patients, visitors and healthcare staff.
• be able to work under pressure, and with a flexible approach.
Why HCA UK?
Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.
By caring for our employees, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That’s why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a Housekeeping Assistant you’ll be eligible for:
• 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
• Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
• Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
• Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
• Group Life Assurance from day one
• Critical illness cover
• Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
• Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
• Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you

At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.
Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:
• Unique and Individual: We recognise and value everyone as unique and individual

Help Shape the Future of Flight
Ready to gain hands-on experience developing the next generation of aerospace technology?
At Evolito, we're developing world-leading electric propulsion technology that is transforming aviation and helping create a more sustainable future. Our high-performance electric motors and controllers power some of the most exciting aerospace innovations, from electric aircraft to advanced unmanned aerial vehicles.

As a member of our 12-month Engineering Analysis Industrial Placement Programme, you'll work alongside experienced engineers on live customer projects from day one.
You'll have the opportunity to:
•
Support structural, modal and thermal analyses of electric motor components and assemblies
•
Prepare CAD geometry for finite element analysis and assess results against engineering requirements
•
Help design tests, fixtures and samples used to validate engineering analyses
•
Contribute to concepts that improve product performance, durability and manufacturability
•
Support material selection, root cause analysis and the production of technical reports and recommendations

Receive mentoring and support throughout the programme

•
Finite Element Analysis
•
Structural Analysis
•
Modal & Vibration Analysis
•
Thermal Analysis
•
Geometry Preparation & Meshing
•
Physical Test Correlation & Validation
•
Root Cause Analysis

We're looking for motivated students who:
•
Are studying Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Science or a related discipline
•
Need to complete an industrial placement year as part of their course

Have a good understanding of mechanical engineering principles and an interest in simulation and analysis

Have some exposure to finite element analysis through university or practical projects
•
Are creative, analytical, collaborative and eager to learn
Why Evolito?
This isn't a placement where you'll be sitting on the sidelines. You'll become part of a team of talented engineers working at the forefront of electric aviation. You'll be trusted to contribute, encouraged to innovate and supported to develop both technically and professionally.
By the end of your placement, you'll have gained valuable industry experience, built your professional network and developed skills that will help launch your engineering career.
Benefits
•
Competitive salary
•
30 days annual leave (pro rata)
•
Dedicated mentoring and development support
•
Real project ownership and responsibility
•
Experience in one of the UK's fastest-growing private technology companies
Ready to launch your career?
Join us and help develop the technologies that will define the next era of aviation.

About us:
Are you looking for the ideal start to your engineering career with a world-leading aerospace company? Are you passionate about how things work and enjoy hands-on, high-precision tasks? Would you thrive in a dynamic environment where every day brings a new challenge? If so, this could be the opportunity for you!
This is an exciting opportunity to join Airbus as an apprentice in the Structures Test Team at the Aerospace Integrated Research and Test Centre (AIRTeC) in Filton, Bristol. AIRTeC is a £100 million, state-of-the-art research and testing facility that supports Airbus’s advanced aircraft wing design and development.
The Structures Test Team is one of three key testing centres within Airbus, responsible for validating the strength and durability of cutting-edge materials and structural components used across all Airbus aircraft programmes, including next-generation, sustainable technologies like hydrogen propulsion, ultra-flexible wings, and blended wing body aircraft..
What will you be doing:
Year 1: During your first year you will spend Semester 1 (September to January) full-time studying at Weston College. In Semester 2 (February to June) you will start to spend 2 days per week onsite at Airbus Filton, with the other days at Weston college.
Years 2 and 3: Time to put your learning to action!
In second and third years, you will be on-site at Airbus Filton. As a Structures Test Apprentice, you will support the delivery of critical test campaigns by working on a wide range of mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation tasks. You will learn practical skills and technical knowledge across two key areas:
Year 4: Apprentices will be based in their place of work on a full-time basis
Core Activities (Common to Both Roles):
• Machining tasks using lathes, mills, and surface grinders to modify or create simple components.
• Mechanical assembly of test specimens, rigs, and hydraulic systems – from small component tests to full aircraft wing evaluations.
• Installation of test instrumentation including sensors, inclinometers, string potentiometers, and high-speed cameras.
• Use of metrology techniques to perform precise physical measurements.
• Cable manufacture and creation of bespoke connectors.
• Installing and commissioning control and data acquisition systems.
• Participating in laboratory-based activities and supporting the test lifecycle from preparation to execution.

You’ll rotate through various disciplines and support the full test process—from component manufacturing to test execution and data acquisition—gaining a comprehensive understanding of how large aerospace structures are evaluated.

This position has a strong focus on metrology and calibration activities. You will work closely with our calibration engineers to ensure all measurement and test equipment is functioning accurately and meets regulatory standards. Responsibilities include:
• Performing calibrations on instruments such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, pressure gauges, and temperature sensors.
• Maintaining and updating calibration records and databases.
• Troubleshooting and repairing faulty equipment.
• Developing and optimising software-based calibration procedures.
• Ensuring compliance with quality management systems such as ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 17025.
• Supporting development of new calibration techniques and procedures.
Note: Both roles offer opportunities to travel to other Airbus sites (e.g., Hamburg, Toulouse) and external suppliers to provide support and gain international experience.

• Gain real-world experience working alongside industry experts in a high-tech environment.
• Build a blend of mechanical and electrical skills relevant to testing, calibration, and instrumentation.
• Develop professionally through structured training, academic learning, and hands-on projects.
As you progress, you’ll have the opportunity to specialise in areas aligned with your interests—whether that’s mechanical testing, data acquisition, or advanced calibration and metrology.
Requirements

• Achieve a minimum of five GCSEs which must include:
• Grade C or 4 in Maths (B or 5 preferred)
• Grade C or 4 in English
• Plus 3 other GCSEs at grade C or 4;

Role: FP&A Project Manager - 12 Month FTC
Company: SEGA Europe Ltd
Working model: Hybrid (3 days in office per week)
Location: Building 12, Chiswick Business Park, 566 Chiswick High Road, London, W4 5AN
About the role
SEGA Europe’s Finance, Business Planning and Studio Finance teams are moving FP&A data, reporting and planning from fragmented, Excel-driven processes to governed, scalable CPM solutions. At the same time, these teams are changing how they work. We are looking for a finance-literate Project Manager to bring one consistent delivery standard to both – running the PMO for our CPM programme and data initiatives, driving process transformation, and making sure Finance processes are properly documented.
What you will do
PMO for the CPM programme and data-driven initiatives
• Plan and run delivery across a portfolio of concurrent initiatives – plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID, change control and status reporting.
• Keep progress transparent at all times: where each initiative stands, what is outstanding, who owns the next action, and what is needed to finish.
• Coordinate UAT, parallel testing, cutover and go-live with Finance, Business Planning, Studio Finance, IT, HR and implementation partners.
• Set and maintain PMO standards, templates and a single portfolio view; run the delivery cadence and steering committee packs.
• Support master data governance, including taking over the Title Master (our governed list of game titles) and its change control.
• Use AI tools to automate routine project management work, measure the time saved, and help colleagues adopt the same practices.
Process transformation
• Map the processes and handoffs affected by change, and plan the transition around the Finance calendar (month-end close, budget, forecast and mid-term planning).
• Identify adoption risks early; plan communications, training and readiness so new ways of working are adopted, not left to settle informally.
Process documentation
• Help Finance teams document their processes using the AI tools available, and keep that documentation current on a regular cycle.
• Make sure project, process and governance documents are complete, approved and easy to find, with decisions recorded when they are made.
• Reduce reliance on individual knowledge, so absence or handover never stalls an initiative.
What you will bring
• 5–8 years’ project management experience, including CPM/EPM, financial systems or finance transformation delivery.
• Solid understanding of the full finance cycle – financial accounting and month-end close as well as FP&A reporting, budgeting and forecasting.
• Experience running several initiatives at once in a matrix organisation, managing a wide range of stakeholders at different levels.
• Experience of process mapping, process documentation and supporting organisational change.
• Working knowledge of master data, hierarchies and change control; structured UAT and release management.
• Excellent organisational skills, with hands-on use of project management tools (e.g. Smartsheet, Jira/Confluence) to keep work on track and transparent.
• Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude, Smartsheet AI) to automate and optimise tasks.
• A confident facilitator who can influence without direct authority, stays calm under pressure and picks up new tools quickly.
• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Nice to have
• CPM/EPM platforms (Vena, Anaplan, Adaptive, Hyperion); ERP systems such as Oracle; HRIS.
• PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or change management certification (e.g. Prosci); ACA, ACCA or CIMA (full or part-qualified).
• Experience in a global organisation, ideally in video games.
Working environment
London-based, hybrid: three days in the office and two days working from home.

We offer competitive salaries and a fantastic bonus scheme so that you can stay motivated and focused on making SEGA the best it can be.

•
We pride ourselves on having flexible working hours to ensure that you have a life outside of the office.
•
We want people of all backgrounds to see themselves represented and included in our work, so we actively seek to diversify our team and bring more voices to the table. All applicants are welcome!

Group/Division

• A solid understanding and demonstrated track record in the practice of software engineering fundamentals, including architecture, data structures, design patterns, event-driven design, multithreaded design, testing, and debugging.
• Experience with:
Microsoft .NET languages including VB.NET and C#
C++ programming
Microsoft Visual Studio development environment
Source code control systems such as Git
• Adherence to software design and coding standards
• Ability to communicate effectively with peers, interdisciplinary engineering groups, customers, and suppliers, including delivering clear technical presentations

Function Purpose / Summary
The UK Finance Operations function safeguards Roche UK Pharma’s financial integrity and licence to operate while enabling the organisation to work efficiently and make sound business decisions.
The function brings together Accounting, Internal Controls & Financial Compliance (“ICFR”), Audit, and Procurement, providing clear local accountability while connecting Roche UK with Roche Services & Solutions (RSS), Group Finance, Tax and other global specialist organisations.
The function ensures that the  Finance requirements of the Roche Group,  UK statutory reporting,and all other regulatory obligations are translated into effective local processes, controls and practical business solutions.

The Head of UK Finance Operations is the senior leader accountable for the integrity, compliance and effectiveness of Finance Operations across Roche UK.
Serving as Site Controller and the senior point of accountability for operational finance matters across the UK site, the role maintains a holistic view of financial topics affecting the legal entity and site.

Leonardo offers a range of Apprenticeships from 2-4yrs. across a variety of STEM and business routes, offering paid training, coupled with on the job learning that enables you to gain practical skills, experience and knowledge that sets up the best start to your career. We offer competitive entry salaries and fully support your academic learning through to qualifications, with salary increases as you progress.
Whether leaving School or College with GCSEs/Standards, A Levels/Highers (or equivalent) or in work and looking for a new career path, you are fully supported as you rotate within the business working on real-time projects alongside highly skilled professionals who are passionate about their work. We support helping you settle into your new location ensuring you are familiar with the team and have a warm welcome from day 1.
There is a member of our Apprentice team at each site, helping you progress, ensuring your study time is protected, enabling access to digital learning as well as opportunities to get involved with the local community and STEM projects, enhance many aspects of each programme. Through a combination of software, network, platform, DevOps, data, delivery and security placements, you will develop the knowledge and practical experience needed to design, build, deploy, operate and secure modern digital systems.
The starting salary for this role is £23,500 per annum.
The Role
Looking for a great start to your career in technology, earning and learning on a professionally accredited, award-winning scheme? We are recruiting the cyber, software, network, platform, DevOps, data and security professionals of the future on our nationally recognised, award-winning Degree Apprenticeship Programme.
Our Cyber Degree Apprenticeship is broader than a traditional cybersecurity programme. It provides experience across the disciplines involved in designing, building, testing, deploying, operating and securing modern digital systems.
This three-year programme combines Cyber Delivery (Engineering & Data) and Cyber Security, providing you with hands-on experience and a strong foundational skill set across engineering, data and security disciplines before you specialise in a chosen path.
During Years 1 and 2, you will complete a series of placements across key areas, including:
• Core Foundational Skills
• System Development (Software, Network, Platform, DevOps and Test)
• Data & Analytics (AI/ML, Data Engineering and Visualisation)
• Security Risk & Governance and Audit & Assurance
• Operational Security, including exposure to Security Operations Centres (SOC), threat detection, vulnerability management and incident response
• Cyber Project Delivery, providing an understanding of how multidisciplinary teams plan, coordinate and deliver cyber and digital projects
• Exposure to how Architecture supports secure system design, engineering and technical decision-making
In Year 3 you'll begin to specialise more in either Cyber Delivery or Cyber Security, having the opportunity to take on placements more focused on your chosen area and develop deeper expertise in preparation for a permanent role within the business.
Throughout your apprenticeship, you will:
• Balance your time between work and studying for a BSc (Hons) or BEng (Hons) in Cyber Security.
• Gain hands-on experience and practical skills in areas such as:
• Secure system and network design.
• Software, network, platform, DevOps and test engineering.
• Installing and configuring operating systems, firewalls and applications.
• Deploying and using secure Cloud environments such as AWS and Azure.
• Using DevOps practices and tooling to support secure software development, automation and deployment.
• Data analytics with Machine Learning and AI.
• Detecting and remediating cyberattacks.
• Security design and architecture, security testing and response investigations.
• Risk analysis, governance and compliance.
• Understanding how cyber and digital projects are planned and delivered.
• Engage in STEM outreach and community initiatives.
During your Apprenticeship we encourage you to spend at least 3/4 days a week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience.
Your work will support critical business areas throughout Leonardo and our customers in the UK government and private sector and will provide you with great learning opportunities in the field. At the same time, you will obtain the academic knowledge and qualifications necessary for your future career in a high-tech company through your course at one of our partner universities.
You will be working within world-class facilities, in both office and lab environments and will have opportunities to travel to other Leonardo UK and customer sites, to meet with colleagues, customers, and suppliers.
Beyond the programme there may be the opportunity for you to further your academic and vocational achievements based on your talents and capability and needs of the business. You would be expected to commit to the successful completion of all your academic modules and assignments in support of the Apprenticeship standard.
What We’re Looking For
This Apprenticeship assumes little prior cybersecurity experience and is NOT suitable for candidates who already have an engineering, software or computing degree.
Qualification Requirements:
• 3 A-Levels (Grades A–C)
•
• One must be in Mathematics and another in Physics or an Engineering/Technology/IT related subject.
OR
• BTEC Extended Diploma in Engineering (with maths bridging course).
Plus:
• 5 GCSEs (Grades 9–4 / A*–C) including English, Maths, and a Science subject.
We consider each application individually in consultation with our partnering university.
Security Clearance
At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations.  As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. Job Description:
The opportunity:
Our Central London team is looking for talented and enthusiastic modelling and simulation practitioners to create and integrate weapon system models for our UK Ministry of Defence (MOD) customer. The role will suit either recent STEM graduates, postgraduates, or those with relevant industry experience of engineering models who wish to apply their abilities in an aerospace modelling and simulation environment. This is intended as a fulltime position, but we would consider part time working of 4 days per week.
• Role includes a 12.% Salary Uplift.
The type of project will you be working on:
• Customer Integration: You will be a member of a weapons project team within our larger Defence Analytics Group working in Central London. The group is integrated into a joint unit with government employees, members of the armed forces, and other contractors.
• The Challenge: To create dynamic computer models for internal and external simulation environments to assess the performance and capability of weapon systems. Complex systems are modelled primarily in MATLAB/Simulink, exercised to answer customer questions, and exported for integration into customers’ modelling environments.
• Collaboration: You will be working in close liaison with teams within the UK and partner nations, with the opportunity to contribute, influence, challenge and improve joint ways of working and knowledge.
• Breadth: You will be working in an environment where both the complexity and capabilities of the systems are continually evolving throughout the world.
What you’ll do as a Defence Analytics Engineer:
• Produce computer models of weapons systems, exercise them in-house, and aid the integration of these models in customers’ simulation environments.
• Produce reports and presentations of your work and present them to local MOD customers and the wider community both within the UK and partner nations.
• Provide ad hoc advice and support to MOD customers, often at short notice.
• Use your developing experience and knowledge to propose and implement improvements to tools and processes.
• In conjunction with the project team conduct regular liaison with both MOD and the wider customer base to keep them informed of recent developments and to determine future analysis requirements.
• Seek co-operative and collaborative approaches with our UK and multi-national partners, identifying best practice.
• Travel for technical exchanges with our partners, in the UK and abroad.
What we need from you:
• A good understanding of scientific methods and their use through the application of fundamental physical principles.
• A degree in a STEM subject and strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to apply these to real world problems through modelling and simulation.
• Knowledge of aerospace technologies such as aerodynamics, propulsion, sensors, guidance and control would be an advantage.
• Experience in some of the following programming languages: MATLAB/Simulink, C/C++, C# and/or Python.
• Good interpersonal skills which allow you to work collaboratively and effectively within an inter-disciplinary team.
• Ability to problem solve and self-steer work to deadlines as necessary, sometimes at short notice.
• Ability to communicate, both in writing and verbally, with audiences of differing technical backgrounds and seniority.
It would be nice if you had:
• Experience of defence modelling and simulation environments, customers and requirements would be an advantage.
What you will get:
• Impact: You will help ensure that MOD’s weapon assessments are robust and delivered in a timely manner to UK Defence partners and front-line forces. This will be in the form of computer models and product generated from these models.
• Opportunity: To play a key role in MOD weapon assessment which is a critical input to MOD’s equipment procurement programs.
• Knowledge: You will develop a detailed understanding of weapon systems and how they operate, and how to encapsulate that understanding and assessment in a dynamic computer model.
• Skills: You will develop a range of analytical, software and interpersonal skills.
• Insights: Working within a Leonardo team that is fully integrated with its MOD customer will provide an excellent opportunity to see up-close how the MOD operates and interacts with its customers and partners.
• Teamwork: You will work with a diverse technical team in a highly collaborative, multi-national environment.
• Delegation: It is expected that you will steer tasks, processes and improvement initiatives.

Founded in 2012 by renowned game developer Chris Roberts, Cloud Imperium Games (CIG) is one of the largest global independent studios, dedicated to delivering next-generation AAA games. CIG prides itself in thinking outside the box, encouraging creativity and developing ground-breaking technology. CIG believes in raising the bar for the gaming industry and the gaming community as a whole.
About the Role
As a Senior Lighting Artist at CIG, you will be joining a team responsible for lighting all the amazing locations in Star Citizen.  Star Citizen is a universe filled with solar systems, each of which are filled with diverse locations all of which the player can seamlessly fly down to from space and explore on foot.
In this senior position, you will take ownership of implementing and overseeing high-quality, complex, and cinematic realtime lighting scenarios for Star Citizen. This could be anything from a moody old Space Station in low orbit around a planet to a neon-filled cityscape located on a planet. The art pillars of the game are Cinematic Sci-Fi Realism. You will play a pivotal role in establishing the mood, tone, and visual quality for environments, ensuring the final frame showcases the artwork to the highest possible industry standard.
This is an onsite role based at our studio in Manchester, UK.
Check out what our Lighting team get up to:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cqt1fl56BlE&t=1s
What does a Senior Lighting Artist at CIG do?
• Create and champion believable, cinematic and narrative-driven lighting scenarios for major locations in the game.
• Optimise and ensure complex lighting setups work seamlessly within strict defined realtime rendering budgets, proactively identifying performance bottlenecks.
• Work closely with the Lighting Lead and Art Director to interpret, execute, and help maintain the overall artistic vision across the project.
• Collaborate deeply with other departments (Environment Art, Tech Art, Design) to pioneer workflows and help create the best player experience possible.
• Act as a technical and artistic resource for junior and mid-level artists, helping elevate the team’s collective skillset.
What do we expect from our Senior Lighting Artists?
• Extensive experience in creating high-quality, AAA realtime lighting scenarios, with a strong portfolio showcasing a masterful handle on mood and composition.
• Someone who is deeply passionate about creating inspirational lighting moods and storytelling through light.
• Deep understanding of material shading, physically based rendering (PBR), and how the interplay of different materials impacts the final frame under varying light conditions.
• A profound knowledge of cinematic lighting principles (composition, colour theory, exposure) combined with the technical know-how to implement them in a cutting-edge engine.
• Someone who draws from a vast variety of reference material to constantly challenge themselves and push the boundaries of what is possible in realtime games.
• Excellent communication skills, with a collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive within a highly passionate, fast-paced team environment.
If you have a proven track record of creating beautiful, exotic sci-fi environments that players get lost in, and you are ready to help lead the charge on a groundbreaking universe, please apply immediately!
Diversity Statement
CIG is a global company, staunchly committed to cultivating a culture and workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, lifestyles, and perspectives. Together, we are creating a space where authentic recognition, appreciation, and understanding of the importance of diversity is fostered by everyone. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to build a team that represents all walks of life, and we want every employee to bring all the things that make them unique to the work environment. The universe is as vast and varied as the people in it, and it’s our differences that make it special.
Fraud Statement
We are aware of people receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from CIG. These types of fraud can be carried out through false websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal info like bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc through social media or chat-based apps, nor do we request or send money for the purchase of business equipment.
If you suspect fraud, please report it to your local authorities, as well as reaching out to us at info[@]cloudimperiumgames.com with any information you may have.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Title and Summary
Director of Capacity Management
The opportunity
Vocalink is looking for a Director of Capacity Management to establish and lead our enterprise approach to capacity and capability planning.
This is a strategic leadership role that will give our Executive team a clear, forward-looking view of whether we have the people, skills and capacity required to deliver our strategic priorities, regulatory commitments, operational resilience obligations and technology investment plans.
You'll connect portfolio demand with workforce capacity, identifying where constraints or critical capability gaps could affect delivery and helping leaders make informed decisions about priorities, investment, recruitment, sourcing and the deployment of specialist skills.
Working across Technology, Product, Operations, Finance, HR, Business Change and Agile Release Train leadership, you'll establish the data, governance, processes and tooling needed to create a consistent and trusted enterprise view of capacity.
What you'll do
Build our enterprise capacity management capability
• Establish and lead a consistent enterprise approach to capacity planning across Technology, Product, Operations, Business Change and supporting functions.
• Create a trusted, organisation-wide view of capacity, capability and resource availability.
• Develop capacity forecasts across a rolling 12–36 month horizon, aligned to our portfolio roadmap and strategic priorities.
• Establish the standards, governance and processes that enable sustainable capacity management across Vocalink.
Connect portfolio demand with supply
• Translate current and future portfolio demand into resource and capability requirements.
• Identify capacity constraints, resource bottlenecks and delivery risks before they affect our strategic commitments.
• Develop scenario modelling that enables senior leaders to understand the resource implications of different portfolio and investment choices.
• Provide evidence-based recommendations on recruitment, redeployment, outsourcing, offshore capability and third-party augmentation.
• Play a key role in quarterly planning, Strategic Portfolio Reviews, annual investment planning and longer-term strategic planning.
Shape workforce and capability decisions
• Establish an enterprise view of the skills and specialist capabilities required to deliver our strategy.
• Identify critical capability gaps, succession risks and areas of key-person dependency.
• Partner with HR, Talent Acquisition and functional leaders to translate future capability requirements into actionable workforce plans.
• Inform recruitment, onboarding, insourcing, outsourcing and location strategies for strategic initiatives.
Turn data into executive insight
• Develop reporting and dashboards that give senior leaders clear insight into demand, available capacity, utilisation, capability gaps and emerging risks.
• Improve the quality and integration of capacity and demand data across Workday, Jira and portfolio management tooling.
• Increase automation across capacity reporting and forecasting.
• Explore how AI and advanced analytics can improve forecasting, scenario planning and decision-making.
What you'll bring
We're looking for somebody who can combine strategic thinking with the ability to build a new enterprise capability and influence decisions at the highest levels of the organisation.
Essential experience
• Senior leadership experience in enterprise capacity, portfolio, resource or strategic workforce planning within a complex technology or transformation environment.
• Experience designing or significantly developing an enterprise-scale capacity or demand-planning framework.
• Strong understanding of how portfolio demand, delivery capacity, skills and workforce planning interact.
• Experience of forecasting demand and capacity and using scenario analysis to support investment or prioritisation decisions.
• Experience working within Agile delivery environments, with an understanding of SAFe and/or Lean Portfolio Management principles.
• A track record of turning complex data into clear recommendations for Executive-level stakeholders.
• Strong influencing and communication skills, with the ability to build alignment across multiple functions and senior stakeholder groups.
It would be advantageous if you also have
• Experience in financial services, payments, critical national infrastructure or another highly regulated environment.
• Knowledge of operational resilience, regulatory change and risk management.
• Experience of capacity or workforce analytics using Power BI, SQL, Power Platform or comparable tools.
• Experience introducing AI-enabled forecasting, modelling or planning capabilities.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
•
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
•
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
•
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
•
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Senior Investment Valuation Analyst
Location: London - hybrid 50%
Contract: Permanent
Hours: Full time 35 hours
Purpose of the role
Support the Head of Investment Valuations in overseeing the independent valuation framework across the investment portfolio, ensuring valuations are robust, well governed, and appropriate for financial reporting, risk management, and regulatory requirements. Provide technical expertise on complex valuation matters, drive continuous improvement of valuation processes and controls, and act as a trusted partner to Investment, Finance, Risk, and senior governance stakeholders.
About Just
We help people achieve a better later life. That’s our purpose and it’s the reason we exist. We are a fast-growing company helping customers enjoy the retirement they deserve. We do this through a variety of market leading, award-winning products and services, delivered by a diverse team of over 1,250 purpose-led colleagues who genuinely put the customer at the heart of everything we do.
This is a brilliant time to join our business. We are on an exciting growth journey to become the UK’s most loved retirement expert.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead independent valuation reviews and price verification across the investment portfolio, ensuring accurate and timely valuation outcomes.
• Oversee valuation activity across a broad range of asset classes, including fixed income, derivatives, private credit, structured products, LPI assets, real estate, and other Level 3 investments.
• Assess and challenge valuation methodologies, assumptions, models, and market data to ensure fair value principles are consistently applied.
• Develop and maintain valuation approaches for new and existing asset classes, with particular focus on complex and illiquid investments.
• Monitor valuation controls and investigate valuation exceptions, breaches, and discrepancies, implementing corrective actions where required.
• Drive improvements to valuation models, processes, data quality, and analytical tools to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
• Produce valuation reporting, management information, and committee papers to support decision-making and governance requirements.
• Support the development and maintenance of liquidity models used to assess the Company's ability to meet cash flow obligations under normal and stressed market conditions.
• Deliver liquidity stress testing and scenario analysis, identifying potential vulnerabilities and informing liquidity risk management.
• Contribute to regulatory, audit, and financial reporting activities by providing valuation and liquidity-related analysis, insight, and documentation.
What We're Looking For
• Significant experience in investment valuation, investment risk, market risk, investment finance, or asset management within a life insurer, asset manager, pension fund, investment bank, or consultancy.
• Demonstrated expertise in valuing and providing oversight across a diverse range of asset classes, including fixed income, private credit, derivatives, structured finance, real estate, and other illiquid or Level 3 investments.
• Deep technical knowledge of private credit (preferred) and/or derivatives is essential.
• Sound understanding of derivative instruments, including repos, cross-currency swaps, interest rate swaps, total return swaps (TRS), and FX forwards, together with knowledge of illiquid and structured credit assets.
• Extensive knowledge of valuation methodologies, fair value principles, and relevant regulatory and accounting frameworks, including IFRS and Solvency II
• Experience of independent price verification (IPV), valuation governance, control frameworks, and the review and challenge of valuation models, assumptions, and market data.
• Highly developed analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to assess complex investment structures, valuation uncertainty, model risk, and liquidity risk.
• Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, challenge, and present complex information clearly to senior leaders, committees, auditors, and external partners.
• Track record of delivering process improvements and enhancing valuation systems, controls, reporting, automation, and data quality.
• Degree in a STEM-related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable numerical capability. Advanced Excel skills are essential, while experience with Python or VBA would be advantageous.
Our behaviours
At Just you’ll have the opportunity to develop your career, whilst making a difference to the lives of those around you. You’ll be part of a company with a strong and distinctive culture - we’re ambitious, curious and collaborative – and every decision we make centres around being Just and delivering the best outcomes for our customers.
What’s in it for you
• A competitive salary, pension scheme and life assurance
• 25 days annual leave plus an additional day on us for your birthday
• Private medical cover and income protection, just in case
• A generous and highly achievable bonus scheme
• Opportunities to progress your career in-role and within the company
• Free access to the Headspace app, 24/7 employee assistance helpline and trained physical and mental health first aiders
• A variety of employee funded benefits available via our online benefits portal
• Plus, several additional purchase options available for you and your loved ones
Explore our full range of benefits on our dedicated benefits page.
Belonging at Just
Valuing diversity of thought and fostering a sense of belonging is critical to our business success, driving innovation and balanced decision making. Our work on DEIB (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging) aims to deliver a brilliant employee experience underpinned by a sense of belonging, where our people feel proud to work at Just.
We remain committed to our publicly disclosed HM Treasury Women in Finance Charter and Race at Work Charter targets and support a wide range of employee network and events, championing issues including intergenerational working, social mobility and neurodiversity.
Be Bold. Be Brilliant. Be Just.

Department: InfoSec
Location: London - 3 days on-site
Full Time
Ready for a challenge?
Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

About this role
JET's Information Security organisation protects a technology-led, cloud-native platform serving millions of customers across multiple markets.
JET's Security Governance function sets the standards that keep a large, cloud-native technology organisation secure and compliant. As Operational Governance Lead, you'll own the operational delivery of JET's governance framework maintaining policies and controls, running assurance processes, and making security requirements work in practice for engineering and product teams. You'll be the day-to-day connective tissue between L1 engineering, L2 risk and compliance, and L3 audit ensuring control evidence flows cleanly and exceptions get resolved.
These are some of the key components to the position:
• Maintain and operationalise JET's security governance documentation policies, standards, and control models keeping them aligned to JET's risk appetite and frameworks including NIST CSF and ISO 27001.
• Run governance forums and working groups, ensuring decisions are documented, tracked, and communicated to engineering, risk, and compliance stakeholders in a timely way.
• Coordinate evidence gathering and control validation across L1, L2, supporting audit cycles and maintaining a clear, accountable control registry.
• Draft and refine technical security standards for cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and third-party integrations, working with Engineering Leads to embed these into delivery workflows.
• Track exceptions and remediation plans with technical owners, escalating risks where needed and maintaining visibility across the Three Lines of Defence.
• Build and maintain KPI/KRI dashboards that provide stakeholders with clear, accurate visibility of control health and compliance posture.
What will you bring to the team?
• Solid hands-on experience in Information Security GRC within a technology-led or cloud-first organisation, with a track record of keeping governance frameworks operational at pace.
• Working knowledge of security control frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and how they apply to modern engineering environments including cloud infrastructure, microservices, and DevOps.
• Proven ability to coordinate across the Three Lines of Defence translating audit and compliance requirements into clear, actionable tasks for engineering teams without creating unnecessary friction.
• Clear communicator who can explain governance requirements and control expectations to both technical engineers and non-technical risk or business stakeholders.
• Organised and delivery-focused, with the ability to manage multiple governance workstreams, track remediation through to closure, and keep processes running in a fast-moving organisation.
• Data-driven approach to compliance tracking comfortable building dashboards, spotting trends in control data, and surfacing the right information to support leadership decisions.
At JET, this is how we play
Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.
Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.
At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.
Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.
Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging
No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. Job Title
Data Privacy Manager
Job Description
Data Privacy Manager
About IG Group
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
About the Role
IG's Data & AI team is scaling up how the business governs, understands, and trusts its data. As our Data Privacy Manager, you'll be the Group's central point of contact for data privacy - closing the gap between policy and practice, taking ownership of the RoPA process, DPIAs, DSAR protocol, retention practices, and breach reporting, and giving IG a single accountable home for data privacy compliance.
About the Team
This role sits within the Data & AI team, reporting into the Head of Data Governance & Strategy. This is an individual contributor role and the first hire into a newly centralised function, so it requires someone comfortable working on their own initiative and building relationships with stakeholders at all levels. As the function scales, this role will pick up direct reports.
Key Responsibilities
As Data Privacy Manager, you'll lead the strategic and day-to-day agenda for data privacy at IG, partnering closely with Legal, Risk, Compliance, HR, Procurement, Technology, and Product colleagues. You'll help evolve a privacy capability that is rigorous where it needs to be and practical everywhere it can be.
• Be the central point of contact for data privacy - act as the go-to for all data privacy related questions across the Group, from policy interpretation to practical guidance for staff at all levels.
• Support the governance framework - support the development of the data privacy governance framework, from DPIAs and privacy by design to retention, RoPA and third-party diligence.
• Own cross-border data transfers - put in place and maintain the mechanisms that allow personal data to move lawfully between IG's UK, EU and international entities, such as Standard Contractual Clauses, the UK International Data Transfer Agreement, and adequacy assessments.
• Own the regulatory interface - manage breach notifications to the relevant regulator within the required regulatory timeframe, DPIA consultations, and centralised data privacy reporting to SLT/Board.
• Advise on privacy by design - advise product and business teams on the privacy implications of new products, changes and customer journeys.
• Translate law into practical guidance - translate UK privacy law into clear, proportionate recommendations that enable responsible decisions.
• Manage complex privacy incidents - including regulatory notification and engagement with affected individuals where required.
• Strengthen privacy awareness - across the business and help build out the privacy function as it grows - running training programmes that go beyond policy awareness to cover breach recognition and escalation for all staff.
• Contribute to the Group's approach to data risk - across a broad range of business activity.
Role Requirements
• 5+ years' experience - in a dedicated data privacy role within a regulated environment.
• Strong working knowledge of UK GDPR and EU GDPR - together with practical awareness of other privacy regimes relevant to IG's international footprint, including practical experience running DPIAs, RoPA and DSAR processes end-to-end.
• Experience operating within a multi-jurisdictional group structure - (e.g. UK, EU, APAC).
• Experience designing and embedding privacy governance documentation - policies, procedures, and escalation routes, ideally in an organisation without an existing dedicated function.
• Comfortable acting as the primary point of contact - for regulators, and for internal Audit and Risk stakeholders, on data privacy matters.
• Strong communication skills - able to translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical guidance for Product, Technology, HR, and other business teams.
• Experience delivering data privacy training and awareness programmes.
Desirable
• Experience in UK financial services or a similarly regulated industry.
• Practical exposure to AI/ML-related privacy considerations - (e.g. automated decision-making, Article 22).
• Professional certification in data protection/privacy - (e.g. CIPP/E, CIPM, BCS Certificate in Data Protection).
The Perks
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
• Competitive salary
• Flexible Benefits Package on top of your salary (12%)
• Private medical cover for you and your family
• Life insurance
• Contribution to gym memberships
• 25 Days holiday, with 1 additional day off to celebrate your Birthday & 2 additional days off a year for voluntary work (28 in total)
• The option to buy or sell holiday days
• A comprehensive global and local onboarding process
• Enhanced primary (maternity), secondary (paternity), and shared parental pay and leave, as well as a range of support and benefits for parents
Learn more about the Perks here!

Job Details:
Job Description:
Altera develops world-class Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) technology which comprises both the FPGA hardware itself and the associated software components, including tools for High-Level Design (HLD) entry.
The two major Altera HLD tools are DSP Builder (based on MATLAB/Simulink) and HLS which are built on a common HLD compiler stack. The HLD compiler generates highly-optimised FPGA RTL including automatic device mapping and pipelining. DSP Builder and HLS users can therefore focus on the architecture of their design without needing to spend time writing and re-writing RTL.
Altera is looking for engineers to join our teams. As a member of the UK DSP Builder team within the HLD group, you will be responsible for:
•
developing and supporting DSP Builder
•
designing and implementing improvements in the HLD compiler stack.

Joining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine. Work with exceptional global teams on a broad pipeline and build a career that makes a real difference for patients.

Author and revise SOPs, technical protocols, and reports while identifying opportunities to improve laboratory workflows, analytical reliability, and stability program execution.

Apply Good Documentation Practices and data integrity principles to ensure analytical results, electronic records, and supporting documentation are accurate, complete, traceable, and readily available for regulatory audits and inspections.

Looking for a Veterinary Surgeon role where you can enjoy a varied caseload, develop your clinical confidence and learn from experienced colleagues? At Cromwell Veterinary Group, you'll have access to the facilities, expertise and support of one of the region's established first-opinion hospitals, with plenty of opportunity to keep progressing throughout your career.
With a varied mix of consulting, surgery and hospital work, an impressive range of diagnostic equipment and a genuine commitment to professional development, this is an opportunity to build your experience in a collaborative environment, with the added benefit of a four-day working pattern in a typical week.
Why join us?
• A varied, flexible clinical role: a mix of consulting, operating and dedicated hospital inpatient shifts, with the opportunity to tailor your working week to your clinical interests.
• A four-day working pattern: typically four 9-hour days per week, with a structured weekend rota and no routine out-of-hours duties.

• Learn from experienced clinicians: join a team of 24 Veterinary Surgeons across the hospital and branch network, including certificate holders and Advanced Practitioners.

Together, they offer a varied first-opinion caseload and access to a broad network of clinical expertise, creating opportunities to learn from colleagues across a wide range of disciplines.
Our hospital is exceptionally well equipped to support the investigation and treatment of a broad range of cases in-house. Facilities include digital radiography and a brand-new ultrasound machine with five probes, including three cardiac probes. We also have rhinoscopy, bronchoscopy, gastroscopy and laparoscopy equipment, alongside a veterinary orthopaedic kit, giving our clinicians access to a range of diagnostic and surgical capabilities.
Our in-house laboratory is equally well stocked, with EPOC, in-house coagulation testing, IDEXX ProCyte, Catalyst and SediVue analysers, as well as Antech HESKAView for digital cytology. These facilities support timely diagnostics and varied clinical work, providing opportunities to build your diagnostic skills and explore areas of clinical interest.
One of Cromwell's greatest strengths is its people. Our team of 24 Veterinary Surgeons includes certificate holders and Advanced Practitioners across medicine, soft tissue surgery, orthopaedics, cardiology, emergency and critical care, ophthalmology, oncology, diagnostic imaging and dentistry. Clinical discussions and shared learning are an important part of hospital life, giving you access to a wealth of knowledge as you continue developing your own skills.
The role involves a mix of consulting days, operating days and dedicated hospital inpatient shifts, with the opportunity to tailor the balance to your clinical interests. You'll work closely with experienced Registered Veterinary Nurses and our dedicated Client Care team, managing a varied caseload while benefiting from the support of the wider hospital team. Some flexibility is required to provide cover at surrounding branches where necessary.
We're also committed to supporting your continued development. You'll receive a £1,500 CPD allowance and 40 hours of CPD leave, with additional support available for Advanced Practitioners. Alongside monthly in-house CPD and structured clinical rounds, you'll have opportunities to learn from colleagues, share knowledge and continue developing your clinical interests.
Our dedicated twilight and night veterinary teams provide continuity of inpatient care around the clock. Rather than patients being transferred elsewhere overnight, patients can remain at Cromwell, cared for by a team that knows their case. This helps us maintain continuity, communication and high standards of patient care throughout their stay.
The working pattern is designed around a four-day week in a typical week, averaging 40 hours across the rota. Weekend duties are structured across a 12-week rota block, with time off in lieu built into the schedule. There are no routine out-of-hours duties for day vets.
Located in the heart of Cambridgeshire, Huntingdon offers a great balance between town and country living, with Cambridge within easy reach. Good road and rail connections make commuting straightforward from Peterborough, St Neots, Bedford and surrounding areas, while the local countryside provides plenty of opportunities to enjoy your time away from work.

We're looking for a Veterinary Surgeon who enjoys first-opinion practice, takes pride in delivering excellent patient care and wants to continue developing their clinical skills as part of a collaborative team.
• RCVS registration.
• At least two years' experience in UK small-animal practice post GDP.
• Confidence managing a varied first-opinion caseload.
• Strong communication and relationship-building skills with a collaborative approach to clinical decision-making.
An interest in pursuing further qualifications or certificates would be welcomed, but is by no means essential. Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to contribute to a supportive clinical team while continuing to grow in their own practice.

1. NPI Program Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration (25%)
• Lead and drive all NPI activities from product concept through final product release while ensuring product conformance to specifications, and seamless transfer to full-volume manufacturing

• Strong knowledge of high-speed serial digital interconnect components and test methodologies
• Experience with JEDEC, and/or Mil quality requirements.

The role will combine accurate execution of pricing activity with proactive identification, analysis and delivery of pricing opportunities across suppliers, products and sourcing programmes.
The Pricing Analyst will evaluate supplier pricing behaviour, market dynamics, pricing-rule adherence and member economics to identify commercial risks and value opportunities. The role will develop fact-based supplier negotiation strategies, lead defined pricing discussions within agreed authority levels, and support broader initiatives to strengthen pricing consistency, supplier accountability and commercial outcomes.
The position will also contribute to the continued development of ClarusONE’s pricing framework, analytics capabilities and supplier-management approach, helping ensure that pricing rules remain commercially effective, operationally practical and aligned with member objectives.

• Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers and key stakeholders to support commercial objectives.
• Prepare negotiation strategies through analysis of historical pricing, market intelligence, supplier performance, and commercial benchmarks.
• Conduct detailed pricing, spend, and market analysis to identify cost-saving opportunities, commercial risks, and value creation initiatives.
• Monitor supplier pricing trends, market dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitive movements to support sourcing and procurement strategies.
• Develop analytical models and reporting to assess pricing performance, supplier behaviour, and category-level opportunities.
• Own or support cross-functional pricing projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, implementation and benefit tracking.
• Develop regular reporting that distinguishes submitted activity from value influenced or delivered by the pricing function.
• Produce regular reporting on pricing trends, savings delivery, supplier performance, and procurement initiatives.
• Measure and communicate the financial impact of projects, negotiations, and process improvements.
• Develop supplier scorecards and performance metrics to evaluate commercial performance, responsiveness, reliability, and compliance.
• Monitor supplier activity and identify indicators of commercial risk, value leakage, or performance concerns.
Basic Requirements:
• Typically, minimum 0-2 years of relevant experience. May have degree or equivalent.
• Experience in pricing, commercial analytics, strategic sourcing, finance and/or supplier management.
• Demonstrated ability to convert complex datasets into commercial actions and recommendations.
• Experience preparing for or participating in supplier or customer negotiations.
• Experience assessing financial impact, constructing commercial scenarios and tracking realised value.
• Pharmaceutical, healthcare distribution, procurement or generic-drug market experience preferred.
• Experience delivering analytical or process-improvement projects across multiple function.
Preferred Skills/Experience:
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to recognise value opportunities beyond basic rule compliance.
• Advanced Excel capability and working knowledge of BI, dashboarding or analytical tools.
• Ability to analyse pricing at product, family, supplier and portfolio levels.
• Confident presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.
• Effective negotiation, influencing and challenge skills.
• Ability to operate within legal, contractual and confidentiality guardrails when providing supplier pricing guidance. Existing guidance materials specifically emphasise avoiding disclosure of one supplier’s pricing or how guidance was derived.

• Strong project management skills, including ownership of milestones, risks, benefits and stakeholder actions.

About the job
The Role
This a portfolio-level regulatory strategy role covering regions with diverse regulatory requirements and market dynamics: APAC, LATAM, MEA, CIS, Adriatics and Partner Business Regions. Working with the Therapeutic Area Lead, you'll set regional regulatory strategy for a defined product portfolio — not just chasing individual approvals, but shaping the pathway decisions, life cycle management, and health authority relationships that determine how well global strategy actually lands on the ground.
Location: Maidenhead/Hybrid, 3-days a week on-site
Why It Matters
A global regulatory strategy depends on strong regional insights across all markets. These regions do not follow the same dynamics as the US or EU — different evidentiary bars, different timelines, different risk calculus — and getting that wrong costs approval time and access. This role owns that judgment: turning global strategy into regionally credible submissions and pushing regional intelligence back up into global thinking before it becomes a problem rather than after.
What You'll Be Responsible For
You'll act as the regional regulatory strategist for your product portfolio, balancing scientific rigor with the practical realities of dozens of different regulatory systems, while building the relationships — internal and external — that make timely approval possible.
• Develop and implement regional regulatory strategies aligned to global priorities, identifying the most efficient approval pathways with input from Local Regulatory Responsible (LRR) and Regulatory Partner Representative (RPR) colleagues
• Contribute to Global Regulatory Strategy activities, including planning and responding to complex scientific questions requiring product expertise and cross-functional input
• Provide strategic oversight of submissions — marketing applications, life cycle management, tender applications, and PSURs — anticipating regulatory risk before it becomes a delay
• Ensure high-quality submission documentation and health authority responses, delivered on schedule and to regional requirements
• Build and sustain strong working relationships with LRRs, RPRs, internal stakeholders, and regional health authorities themselves
• Stay current on international legislation and guidance relevant to CSL's products and initiatives, including rare disease, orphan drug, toll manufacturing, and reliance pathway considerations
Experience Required
• Substantial experience in regulatory affairs within pharma or biotech, with direct exposure to APAC, LATAM, or comparable emerging-market regulatory environments
• A degree in Biological or Medical Science or Pharmacy, preferably with a post-graduate qualification
• Demonstrated ability to develop and execute regional regulatory strategy in alignment with global product strategy
• Strong working knowledge of marketing application, life cycle management, and PSUR/reporting requirements across multiple jurisdictions
• Experience engaging directly with health authorities, with a track record of clear, credible communication that supports positive outcomes
• Comfort operating as a subject matter expert — assessing regulatory impact, identifying risk, and advising cross-functional teams accordingly
• A collaborative style suited to matrixed, multi-stakeholder environments, with the judgment to prioritize across a live portfolio
• English is mandatory, while additional language skill would be an asset (e.g. Arabic, French, Spanish, Russian)
About CSL Seqirus
CSL Seqirus is part of CSL. As one of the largest influenza vaccine providers in the world, CSL Seqirus is a major contributor to the prevention of influenza globally and a transcontinental partner in pandemic preparedness. With state-of-the-art production facilities in the U.S., the U.K. and Australia, CSL Seqirus utilizes egg, cell and adjuvant technologies to offer a broad portfolio of differentiated influenza vaccines in more than 20 countries around the world.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/.
Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL.
You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Senior Embedded Software Developer
The opportunity
Make Unity run everywhere! That is the mantra of the Embedded OS Platforms team. Users expect stunning interactive experiences everywhere: from in-car infotainment systems and digital cockpits to touch-screen kiosks in showrooms and at sporting events. Unity is at the forefront with our scalable, performant runtime engine and Unity Editor workflow.
We are looking for a senior software engineer to join our growing team. The team builds and supports the Unity versions that run on Embedded platforms, like Embedded Linux, QNX and Android Automotive OS. As UX evolves to include multiple screens, layering of 3D content with other applications and rich multi-touch input, our platform grows to match expectations.
Unity is committed to solving the hardest technical challenges, and this role plays a key part in delivering industry solutions for our customers. You will work with teams across Unity, including industry teams who work directly with customers and R&D teams responsible for cross-platform support, systems architecture, libraries, as well as runtime optimization.
What success looks like
In your first 3-6 months, you've ramped up on one of our embedded platforms, shipped your first integrations and bug fixes, and become a trusted contributor in customer-facing investigations.
Within 12 months, you own a meaningful area of a platform (e.g. AAOS integration) its performance on constrained embedded SoCs and act as a technical point of contact for one of our customers. You guide team wide initiatives with your experience and expertise.
Your impact
You'll be part of a small, senior team with a strong impact. The code you write ships in production vehicles, and your work directly unblocks Unity's embedded and automotive business. You'll help define the technical bar across the team and shape how Unity supports the next generation of software-defined vehicles.
Why you'll love it
Genuinely hard problems at the frontier of Real Time 3D and embedded systems. Contribution to cutting edge automotive HMI experiences. A diverse range of responsibilities spanning feature work and customer support. Real ownership, agency and opportunities to grow in a small and senior team that turns the needle and moves the industry forward.

•
Bring Unity's Real Time 3D runtime to embedded platforms, like Embedded Linux, QNX and Android Automotive OS, developing new features and integrations that address the needs of industries like the automotive HMI market.

Integrate Unity into native Android apps (e.g. via Unity Render Service) and build the graphics and windowing layer that powers multi-screen, multi-touch digital cockpits and HMIs.

Profile and optimize KPI like runtime performance, memory, startup/load time and iteration speed of Unity for resource-constrained embedded SoCs across platforms.

Partner directly with customers like automotive OEMs as a technical point of contact, investigating issues, removing performance bottlenecks, and setting customers up for production success.

Raise the engineering bar for a small and senior team through design discussions, code reviews, and automated testing .

•
Languages: Proficiency in C/C++/C\# and building scalable feature sets in a large multithreaded codebase.
•
Embedded Platforms: Experience developing for Embedded Linux, QNX and hypervised environments
•
Android platform: Hands-on AAOS or AOSP development experience on the platform layer, experience integrating into the Android lifecycle as well as using the Android compositing stack (SurfaceFlinger, HWComposer, Gralloc, EGL).
•
Graphics Engineering: Experience developing against Vulkan and OpenGL ES applied to Real Time 3D and UI rendering
•
Performance optimization: Profiling and optimization on resource-constrained hardware using CPU/GPU/IO tooling.
•
Customer collaboration: Working directly with customers on technical issues, with business-level English.
•
Team influence: Become an established senior engineer who guides the team on large cross-platform initiatives.

•
Experience working with or developing Real Time 3D game engines (Unity, Unreal, Godot)
•
Hands-on game development experience
•
Experience developing for embedded and automotive SoC (Qualcomm SA8295/SA8775P, NXP i.MX8/i.MX95, NVIDIA Jetson/DRIVE Orin).
•
Experience working on automotive HMI (cluster, infotainment, ADAS, map navigation)

Relocation support is not available for this position

Work visa/immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

Architecture & Design
• Leading the design and implementation of Zero Trust architectures for enterprise environments, covering users, devices, applications, and data.

• Conducting threat modelling, gap assessments, and risk evaluations for critical applications and network paths.
• Advocate for the adoption of modern security frameworks and secure-by-design principles.
Operations & Optimization

• Ability to translate complex security concepts into business-friendly language.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.

• CISSP, CCSP, or similar security credentials
